news.title: USDT供給量、2022年8月以来最大の減少幅　相場回復には流動性必要＝クリプトクアント
news.summary: クリプトクアントは、イーサリアムとトロン上のUSDT供給量が60日間で81億ドル減少したと報告。仮想通貨相場の持続的回復には流動性の回復が必要と指摘した。

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: ビットコイン採掘、ブロック生成間隔が98分19秒で7月以来の最長
news.summary: ビットコインのマイナーが26日、98分19秒にわたりブロックを見つけられず、7月以来で最長の間隔となった。米ギャラクシー・デジタルのアレックス・ソーン氏がXで明らかにした。

news.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
news.summary: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.

news.title: ビットコインコアで問題発覚、約55円でプライバシー漏えいの恐れ
news.summary: ビットコインコアの開発に携わるイスマイル氏が、ウォレットの再送信機能を悪用してアドレスとノードのIPを1回0.35ドル未満で紐付ける手法を報告した。検証環境では30回すべて成功したが、メインネットでは未検証だ。

news.title: ストラテジー企業価値が保有ビットコイン比で過去最低、投げ売りの局面か＝JPモルガン
news.summary: JPモルガンは25日のレポートで、ストラテジーの企業価値が保有ビットコイン評価額の約0.88倍(mNAV)と過去最低に低下し、仮想通貨市場の投げ売りを示すものと指摘した。一方、ギャラクシーは弱気相場終了の見解を撤回した。

news.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
news.summary: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

news.title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
news.summary: More bitcoin is sitting untouched onchain as the price holds around $60,000, some 50% below its peak,

news.title: How EU brokers could lose access to Kyrgyz crypto exchanges
news.summary: A vote on Kyrgyzstan could make an exchange’s home country the deciding factor in whether a European broker can use it to settle a trade.

news.title: スイス初のビットコイン現物ETFが上場、運用資産350BTC（33億円相当）
news.summary: BIT Asset Managementが26日、スイス初の仮想通貨ビットコイン現物ETFの取引を開始した。ビットコインを直接保有する投資ファンドで、スイス国内の銀行や証券会社を通じて購入できる。

news.title: ビットコイン、5万3250ドルへの下落を警戒＝21シェアーズ
news.summary: 21シェアーズは、ビットコインの下値で注視すべき水準の一つとして実現価格の約5万3250ドルを挙げた。ステーブルコイン供給の18日間の減少幅は2022年のテラ崩壊以来で、バイナンスへのハッキング後の下落は強制清算が深めたと分析している。

news.title: イーロン・マスク、米国の全ての子ども口座にスペースX株式2株を贈呈へ
news.summary: ビットコインを保有する米スペースXは25日、子ども向け投資口座「トランプ口座」のうち有効化済みの口座に新株1株を拠出すると発表した。マスク氏も同数を個人で拠出し、1口座あたり計2株となる。対象口座数と拠出時期は未定。

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 26, 2026

news.title: Bitcoin price eyes $61K as Talos warns of thin Thanksgiving liquidity
news.summary: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in a modest relief rally as Talos questioned crypto demand and the broader outlook for the AI trade.

news.title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
news.summary: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

news.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
news.summary: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

news.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
news.summary: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

news.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
news.summary: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

news.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
news.summary: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

news.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
news.summary: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.

news.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
news.summary: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.

news.title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
news.summary: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.

news.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
news.summary: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

news.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
news.summary: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

news.title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
news.summary: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.
